definitions.explanation: A person whose profession or main pursuit is music — composing, conducting, or performing. Slightly formal in tone; suggests a serious classical or career musician rather than a casual player.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{音楽家|おんがくか}だ。
{将来|しょうらい}は{音楽家|おんがくか}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a musician in the future.

examples.japanese: その{音楽家|おんがくか}は{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}から{多|おお}くの{交響曲|こうきょうきょく}を{作曲|さっきょく}してきた。
examples.english: That musician has composed many symphonies since he was young.

notes:
Composed of {音楽|おんがく} (music) + {家|か} (specialist; "-ist"). Tends to imply a serious or professional pursuit, especially in classical music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音楽家|おんがくか}になる: to become a musician
- {若|わか}い{音楽家|おんがくか}: a young musician
- プロの{音楽家|おんがくか}: professional musician

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ミュージシャン: musician — broader and more contemporary, includes pop/rock players
- {演奏家|えんそうか}: performer; instrumentalist — focuses on playing rather than composing
- {作曲家|さっきょくか}: composer — specifically a music writer
